notes: Not standard: rifampicin RNA-stability time course (0-7 min after rifampicin), all samples with DNP added at the same time; no untreated control. T0 samples: transcription_arrested left out (taken at the moment of rifampicin addition), treatment DNP only. OD 0.8 in M9 succinate is above the inference range, so no phase. Temperature/shaking not stated. WT re-read: unmodified MG1655, so wild_type.
